Looking at this complex problem, I need to track the collection through each transformation step.

## Initial Setup
Starting with 33 items with their sizes, materials, smells, colors, and origins.

## Step 1: Cousin Adds Items
Items with citrus fruits or coffee smell get copies with lavender smell added:
- Item 16 (Chinese bag): copy added
- Item 21 (British stapler): copy added  
- Item 25 (German ball): copy added
- Item 29 (Canadian pen): copy added
New total: 37 items

## Step 2: Aunt Replaces Extra-Extra-Large Items
All extra-extra-large items get replaced with plastic material and coconut smell:
- Items 5, 17, 18, 21, 21', 26, 30 are affected
Material count confirms: 14 plastic (correct for the change)

## Step 3: Dad Removes One Color
Comparing color counts, gray is removed (item 10 was the only gray).
Remaining: 36 items

## Step 4: Remove Items with Even Counts by Type
Types with even counts (ignoring properties except object name):
- Speaker: items 1, 4 (count 2) → both removed
- Scissors: items 9, 20 (count 2) → both removed  
- Vase: items 11, 12 (count 2) → both removed
- Ball: items 25, 25' (count 2) → both removed
- Pen: items 29, 29' (count 2) → both removed

Remaining: 26 items

## Step 5: Fiancée Adds New Smell-Color Pairs
Item 16' has (lavender, khaki), which wasn't in the initial collection.
Fiancée adds a copy of item 16'.
New total: 27 items

## Step 6: Lose One Extra-Extra-Large Item
One of items {5, 17, 18, 21, 21', 26, 30} is lost.
Final count: 26 items

## Final Count

Now I need to count items with ALL of:
- color ≠ pink
- size ≠ extra-extra-large  
- material ≠ glass
- smell ≠ rose
- origin ≠ Spanish

Remaining items after step 5 (before losing one extra-extra-large):

| Item | Color | Size | Material | Smell | Origin | Qualifies? |
|------|-------|------|----------|-------|--------|-----------|
| 2 | black | medium | ceramic | coconut | Portuguese | ✓ |
| 3 | black | medium | ceramic | garlic | British | ✓ |
| 13 | indigo | small | plastic | baking bread | Afghan | ✓ |
| 14 | indigo | extra-large | concrete | chocolate | Russian | ✓ |
| 16 | khaki | medium | steel | citrus fruits | Chinese | ✓ |
| 16' | khaki | medium | steel | lavender | Chinese | ✓ |
| 16'' | khaki | medium | steel | lavender | Chinese | ✓ |
| 24 | purple | small | concrete | gasoline | Afghan | ✓ |

All extra-extra-large items (5, 17, 18, 21, 21', 26, 30) fail the "size ≠ extra-extra-large" criterion, so losing any one of them doesn't affect the count.

Items with glass material or Spanish origin or pink color or rose smell or extra-extra-large size are all excluded.

ANSWER: 8
